name: The Dandy Gent
lead: A relaxed, second-to-none barbershop experience and the makers of handmade beard oils, moustache wax, colognes and wet-shave goods, chosen by barbers across the UK.

experience.title: Our barbershop heritage
experience.text: At just 10 years old, Shane O'Shaughnessy began his barber apprenticeship under his beloved grandad, David Keithley. Today the quality of our barbers and our relaxed experience earn 5-star ratings at all three of our East Midlands shops.

currency_note: Book online in seconds. Free UK delivery on product orders over £25.

special.title: Handmade in Britain
special.text: UK-sourced ingredients only. Our ever-expanding range of handmade grooming products is THE choice of barbers across the UK and beyond.

reviews: I’ve been going to the same barber for years, so I was honestly quite anxious about trying someone new—but I couldn’t be happier with my experience with Josh. From the start, he really took the time to listen to everything I said about my hair, especially regarding my head shape and how I like my fade done.
It was my 1st visit to The Dandy Gent for a High Skin Fade, and I must say Josh is very friendly and polite, and his standard level of work is exceptional. I will definitely be going back again.
Wonderful. Was anxious before because I had the same barber for 10 years and he had to move.
Charlie was a pleasure to have cut my hair. .
